title: 连接句子：先用安全连接词
keywords: 连接句子：先用安全连接词
brain_first: 按原文查阅 连接句子：先用安全连接词

rows: In addition, the activity is free.
This helps because students get real practice.
The road was closed, so we took the train.
The task was difficult, but we finished it.
blocks.text:
Purpose | Safe choices | Example
Add | also, in addition, besides | In addition, the activity is free.
Reason | because, since | This helps because students get real practice.
Result | so, therefore, as a result | The road was closed, so we took the train.
Contrast | but, however, although | The task was difficult, but we finished it.
Example | for example, for instance | For example, students can...
Sequence | first, then, finally | First..., then..., finally...
基础学生优先“短句+清楚连接”，不要一口气写四层从句。
